gloss: rhinitis; inflammation of the nasal mucosa

definitions.gloss: rhinitis — inflammation of the mucous membrane of the nose, causing sneezing, a runny nose, or congestion; includes allergic rhinitis and hay fever
definitions.explanation: A medical term used for inflammation of the nose, whether caused by allergy, infection, or other irritation. The most common compound encountered by learners is {アレルギー{性|せい}{鼻炎|びえん}} (allergic rhinitis), which overlaps heavily with {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever).

examples.japanese: {慢性|まんせい}の{鼻炎|びえん}に{悩|なや}まされている。
examples.english: I've been suffering from chronic rhinitis.

examples.japanese: アレルギー{性|せい}の{鼻炎|びえん}で、{毎年|まいとし}{春|はる}になると{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: I have allergic rhinitis, so every spring is rough for me.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{鼻炎|びえん}と{診断|しんだん}され、{薬|くすり}を{処方|しょほう}してもらった。
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed me with rhinitis and prescribed some medication.

notes:
A medical term composed of {鼻|はな} ("nose") + {炎|えん} ("inflammation"). Covers any inflammation of the nasal mucosa, whether allergic, viral, or chronic.

USAGE:
- Commonly modified by type: {アレルギー{性|せい}{鼻炎|びえん}} (allergic rhinitis), {慢性|まんせい}{鼻炎|びえん} (chronic rhinitis), {急性|きゅうせい}{鼻炎|びえん} (acute rhinitis).
- Takes the verbs {なる} ("to develop"), {ひどい} ("to be severe"), or {悩|なや}まされる ("to be troubled by").
- In everyday speech, many people simply say {鼻|はな}がつまる or {花粉症|かふんしょう} rather than using {鼻炎|びえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アレルギー{性|せい}{鼻炎|びえん}: allergic rhinitis
- {慢性|まんせい}{鼻炎|びえん}: chronic rhinitis
- {鼻炎|びえん}の{薬|くすり}: medicine for rhinitis
- {鼻炎|びえん}の{症状|しょうじょう}: symptoms of rhinitis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}: hay fever — a specific type of allergic rhinitis caused by pollen; much more common in everyday speech.
- {風邪|かぜ}: a cold — often causes temporary rhinitis-like symptoms but refers to the illness as a whole.
- {鼻詰|はなづ}まり: nasal congestion — describes the symptom, not the medical condition.
